# Mozambique

The wealth gradients this library holds for Mozambique: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −1.11 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2022 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **0.09** | DHS 2022 |
| `mort_gradient` | **−0.01** (ages 15–60) | census 2007, own measurement |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.89 | −1.21 | −0.91 | −0.79 | −1.02 | −1.51 | −2.10 |
